changes.after: name: Collect the exports; who: Mei Chen; does: Downloads administrator positions export and trading system positions export (CSV) from portals, saves to shared file drop, counts rows and compares control total in footer line with the file. name: Check cash against the administrator; who: Mei Chen; does: Opens cash tab of reconciliation workbook, pastes administrator cash balances beside trading export balances, one row per Entity per day. Highlights differences over 5,000 USD per Entity per day and opens a break case in the tracker, i

name: Collect manager statements; who: Mei Chen; does: Saves PDF statements to manager folder, types fund, period end, value and received date into statements tracker (Excel), and checks against the expected list. Writes follow-up email if late or missing. Carries forward quarterly funds in months w

name: Convert to SGD; who: Raj Patel; does: Takes holdings values from the tracker and cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end. Holds the pack if no fixing for the date.; system: Excel

name: Review and approve the pack; who: Raj Patel; does: Assembles the pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. Ensures maker is never checker and only manager estimates are used. Reopens review if a late statement revises a value by more than 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund.; system:
name: Read the pack; who: Daniel Foo; does: Reads the issued pack, which shows the version and cutoff time. Logs questions for managers as open questions for the next cycle.; system: report pack
